storyActs.name: Act 1 — The Gathering
storyActs.description: The Collector gathers champions from across the universe.

storyActs.name: Act 2 — The Challenge
storyActs.description: Prove your worth against increasingly difficult foes.

storyActs.name: Act 3 — The Conqueror
storyActs.description: Face the first real tests of your champion roster.

storyActs.name: Act 4 — The Realm of Legends
storyActs.description: Enter the Realm of Legends. The difficulty ramps up significantly.

storyActs.name: Act 5 — The Contest
storyActs.description: The Contest proper begins. Nodes become complex and require specific counters.

storyActs.name: Act 6 — The Mad Titan's Shadow
storyActs.description: Thanos's influence warps reality. Global nodes demand deep rosters.

storyActs.name: Act 7 — The Grandmaster's Play
storyActs.description: The Grandmaster's personal gauntlet. Path selection becomes crucial.

storyActs.name: Act 9 — The End of Time
storyActs.description: The final act. Only the strongest 6/7-star champions will survive.

eventQuests.name: Monthly Event Quest
eventQuests.description: Monthly thematic quest with 5 difficulties. Rewards 5/6/7-star shards, rank-up materials.

eventQuests.name: Monthly Side Quest
eventQuests.description: Side quest running alongside the Event Quest. Shorter paths, unique rewards.

eventQuests.name: Abyss of Legends
eventQuests.description: Permanent endgame content. 10 fights with massive health pools and special nodes.

eventQuests.name: Necropolis
eventQuests.description: The hardest content in MCOC. Requires deep 6/7-star rosters. One-shot fights.

eventQuests.name: Battlegrounds
eventQuests.description: Live PvP mode. Draft 5 attackers and 5 defenders. Compete for seasonal rewards.

eventQuests.name: Carina's Challenges
eventQuests.description: Permanent challenge content. Requires specific champion teams to complete objectives.

eventQuests.name: Incursions
eventQuests.description: 2-player co-op mode. Choose rooms and rooms modifiers. Prizes include 6-star shards.

eventQuests.name: Arena
eventQuests.description: Rotation-based fighting. Win streaks to earn points. Top scorers earn new champions.

difficultyTiers.name: Beginner
difficultyTiers.description: For new players. PI under 5000. Basic nodes only.

difficultyTiers.name: Normal
difficultyTiers.description: Early-mid game. PI 5000-10000. Simple node combinations.

difficultyTiers.name: Hard
difficultyTiers.description: Mid game. PI 10000-18000. Starting to see global nodes.

difficultyTiers.name: Expert
difficultyTiers.description: Late-mid game. PI 18000-30000. Complex node combos.

difficultyTiers.name: Master
difficultyTiers.description: End game. PI 30000-50000. Requires specific counters.

difficultyTiers.name: Grandmaster
difficultyTiers.description: The peak. PI 50000+. Requires deep 6/7-star roster.
